Mode: halftone: dot screen. dither: ordered or noise dithering. ascii: text glyphs chosen by brightness.
Halftonetype: cmyk: four rotated colour screens on Paper. mono: single dot screen in Ink on Paper.
Dithertype: Dither pattern: bayer2, bayer4, bayer8 (ordered), blue (blue-noise approximation) or diffusion (approximate error diffusion).
Cellsize: Cell size in pixels (dot spacing, dither pixel size or glyph size).
Angle: Dot-screen angle in degrees (CMYK adds it to its per-ink angles).
Softness: Softness of the dot edges. 0 = hard.
Levels: Dither mode: levels per channel. 2 = pure on/off.
Dithermono: Dither mode: map luma between Ink (dark) and Paper (light) instead of dithering colour.
Keepcolor: ASCII mode: draw glyphs in the source colour instead of Paper.
Invert: Swap the dark and light mapping.
Ramp: ASCII mode: exactly 10 characters from dark to bright; shorter strings are padded with spaces.
Paper: Light colour (paper, or ASCII glyph colour).
Look: original: the internal demo source keeps its colours. mono: demo source becomes black, bone-white and grey. Only affects the demo shown with in1 unconnected.
Accent: Amount (0-1) of red accent tinted onto one object of the demo source (in1 unconnected). Has no effect on a connected in1.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
